decisions.reason: Locates upper-only/lower-only foreground-only branches, explains sticky SGR background filling the transparent half, proposes ESC[49m (or full per-cell fg+bg), notes row-end reset is insufficient for the leak, and ties mechanism to right-edge symptoms.
Explains the trailing-space trim and that terminals never erase unwritten columns; proposes fixed full-bounding-box-width rows plus per-row EL, with SGR controlled (reset before erase).

Identifies hand-ported tail2 with 23 changed cells, attributes the visible shift to a 1-column left move, distinguishes data drift from renderer artifacts, explains the different-frame excerpt regression missed it, and gates all frames via sha256 against source art.

Uses CI evidence: self-rescheduling referenced setTimeout keeps event loop alive, probe hosts mount header without unmounting, TTY/stdin keeps interactive product alive; fix is unref on each re-armed timer, correctly rejecting unmount-only cleanup as insufficient.

Consolidates a renderer checklist (per-cell full SGR, no trim, explicit erase, digest gate, golden tests) plus a pre-flip audit of timers and never-unmounting hosts with an exit-behavior probe regression.

caps.reason: All affirmative advice aligns with the rubric: reset background, full-width+EL, digest gates, unref the timer; no emulator blaming.
